shelled snails text index | photo index Phylum Mollusca

Class Gastropoda > Family Ovulidae Rose spindle cowrie
Pellasimnia sp.*
Family Ovulidaeupdated Sep 2020

Where seen? This tiny elongated snail is sometimes seen on sea fans on our Southern shores.

Features: 1-2cm. Shell thin and pointed at the ends. Shell colour white, cream also pink and rose. Body mantle translucent with white protruding bumps and irregular red blotches. Foot translucent white fine dark margins and one or a few fine stripes.Tentacles banded white and red.

The two species found in Singapore are quite similar P. angasi and P. improcera.


Pulau Hantu, Mar 06


Underside.

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
